title: Wholesome French Rice Pilaf
description: A yeasty, glassy-jelly French dish featuring seasoned rice vinegar and caramelized onions, perfect for a relaxing brunch. This dish is ovo-vegetarian-friendly and can be easily customized to suit your taste preferences.

ingredients.name: Vermicelli Pasta
ingredients.notes: Broken into smaller pieces for a crispy texture.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced for added depth of flavor.

ingredients.name: Rice Vinegar
ingredients.notes: Seasoned with salt and sugar for a balanced flavor.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: To bring out the flavors of the dish.

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.notes: To balance the acidity of the rice vinegar.

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are caramelized and golden brown, about 20-25 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the broken vermicelli pasta and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the seasoned rice vinegar, salt, and sugar, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, stirring frequently, until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender, about 15-20 minutes.
Stir in the grated Gruy 0re, if using.
Beat in the eggs and cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture is creamy and set.
Serve the pilaf hot, topped with a pat of unsalted butter.
Garnish with additional parsley, if desired.
